nodes.name: Claim the case
nodes.notes: One update that only succeeds if the case still has the status and number of tries the Dispatcher saw. It sets in_progress, counts the try and stamps the time. Only one of several runs racing for the same case gets the row back; the others get an empty item.

nodes.name: Read the case as it is now
Return: not claimed
nodes.notes: Another run has the case, or its status or tries changed since the Dispatcher read it. Nothing is changed; the case's current values are returned.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ caseId: $('When called by the Dispatcher').first().json.caseId ?? null, caseKey: $json.caseKey ?? '', claimed: false, status: $json.status ?? '', reasonCode: $json.reasonCode ?? '', outcome: $json.outcome ?? '', urgent: $json.urgent === true }) }}

nodes.name: Case row and settings usable?
nodes.notes: Safety: n8n turns an expression that fails (for example JSON that cannot be read) into an empty value instead of an error. A corrupt stepsDone would then look like 'no steps done' and a corrupt jointTenants like 'nobody else'. Both, and missing settings, stop the case here as failed.

conditions.leftValue:
={{ [
    !(Array.isArray($json.stepsDone) && $json.stepsDone.every(s => typeof s === 'string')) ? 'stepsDone is not a JSON list of step IDs' : '',
    !(Array.isArray($json.jointTenants) && $json.jointTenants.every(p => p !== null && typeof p === 'object')) ? 'jointTenants is not a JSON list of people' : '',
    !(Array.isArray($json.settings?.landlordNames) && $json.settings.landlordNames.length > 0) ? 'settings.landlordNames is missing or empty' : '',
    !Array.isArray($json.settings?.allowedChangeReasons) ? 'settings.allowedChangeReasons is missing' : '',
    !Array.isArray($json.settings?.deathChangeReasons) ? 'settings.deathChangeReasons is missing' : '',
    !$json.settings?.adapterWorkflowId ? 'settings.adapterWorkflowId is empty' : '',
    !$json.settings?.rbisBaseUrl ? 'settings.rbisBaseUrl is empty' : ''
  ].filter(x => x).length === 0 }}

nodes.name: Error: case row or settings unusable

assignments.name: error
assignments.value:
={{ 'The case row or the settings cannot be used: ' + [
    !(Array.isArray($json.stepsDone) && $json.stepsDone.every(s => typeof s === 'string')) ? 'stepsDone is not a JSON list of step IDs' : '',
    !(Array.isArray($json.jointTenants) && $json.jointTenants.every(p => p !== null && typeof p === 'object')) ? 'jointTenants is not a JSON list of people' : '',
    !(Array.isArray($json.settings?.landlordNames) && $json.settings.landlordNames.length > 0) ? 'settings.landlordNames is missing or empty' : '',
    !Array.isArray($json.settings?.allowedChangeReasons) ? 'settings.allowedChangeReasons is missing' : '',
    !Array.isArray($json.settings?.deathChangeReasons) ? 'settings.deathChangeReasons is missing' : '',
    !$json.settings?.adapterWorkflowId ? 'settings.adapterWorkflowId is empty' : '',
    !$json.settings?.rbisBaseUrl ? 'settings.rbisBaseUrl is empty' : ''
  ].filter(x => x).join('; ') }}

nodes.name: Case details
nodes.notes: kind: moveIn, moveOut (also a death when deathHandling = processAsEnd) or other. rowDate: the row's start date for a move-in, end date otherwise. landlordEndDate / landlordStartDate follow the settings landlordLiabilityEndsOn and landlordLiableFrom. isRetry: this is not the first try.

nodes.name: Resume: RBIS steps already recorded?
nodes.notes: A retry of a case that already changed RBIS carries on from the first step not recorded, and skips the checks (RBIS is partly changed, so check 4 would misread it). A reopened case has its steps cleared by the Dispatcher, so it runs the checks again.

nodes.name: Path: carry on from the recorded steps

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ planMode: 'resume', stepsDone: $('Case details').first().json.stepsDone, account: null }) }}

nodes.name: Check 1: dates real and in order?
nodes.notes: (a) Every date given is a real yyyy-MM-dd date; the date the change needs is there (start date for a move-in, end date for a move-out or death; for any other change reason, at least one date); the end date is not before the start date.

nodes.name: Check 1: a death?
nodes.notes: (b) Deaths are recognised before the allowed-reasons test, so a death is never called 'change reason not valid'.

nodes.name: Check 1: deaths processed as move-outs?
nodes.notes: Setting deathHandling: refer (default) passes deaths to staff; processAsEnd treats them as a move-out from check 2 on.

nodes.name: Check 1: change reason allowed?
nodes.notes: (c) In the allowedChangeReasons setting, and one of the two changes the automation knows how to make.

nodes.name: Check 2: joint row?
nodes.notes: A joint row is a later row of a tenancy in the same file. Its lead row (coveredByCaseKey) does the RBIS work for everyone.

nodes.name: Check 2: what did the lead row do?
nodes.notes: Lead row updated: this row is a duplicate. Lead row referred, failed with no tries left, or missing: refer this row too, so nobody is dropped. With jointTenantHandling = referLaterRows the lead row adds only its own person, so joint rows always go to staff. Lead row still unfinished (should not happen, the Dispatcher runs it first): release this case unchanged for a later run.

value.reasonText: Covered by an earlier row for the same tenancy

nodes.name: Release the case for a later run
nodes.notes: Puts the status and number of tries back to what the Dispatcher saw, so this try does not count and the case is picked up again once its lead row has finished.

nodes.name: Check 3: ask RBIS for the account

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ operation: 'findAccount', rbisBaseUrl: $('Case details').first().json.settings.rbisBaseUrl, ref: $('Case details').first().json.case.accountRef, params: { address: $('Case details').first().json.case.address, postcode: $('Case details').first().json.case.postcode } }) }}

nodes.name: Check 3: account found?
nodes.notes: Found means the account exists and its address and postcode match the row's (after normalise).

nodes.name: Retry: first RBIS change already made by an earlier try?
nodes.notes: Addition to the design (see build notes). If an earlier try's first RBIS call (ending the liability) worked but its reply was lost, no step was recorded, yet nobody is liable now and check 4 would misread the account. On a retry only: if nobody is liable and the liability this case ends has ended on exactly the case's date, record endLiability as done and carry on with the remaining steps.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('Case details').first().json.isRetry && ['moveIn', 'moveOut'].includes($('Case details').first().json.kind) && $json.data.account.current.length === 0 && $json.data.account.liabilities.some(l => $('Case details').first().json.kind === 'moveIn' ? ($('Case details').first().json.landlordNamesNormalised.includes(String(l.party ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim()) && l.end === $('Case details').first().json.landlordEndDate) : (String(l.party ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim() === String($('Case details').first().json.case.tenantName ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim() && l.end === $('Case details').first().json.case.endDate)) }}

nodes.name: Retry: record the first change as done
Path: carry on after the earlier try's first change
Check 4: who is liable in RBIS now?
nodes.notes: Uses the account read in check 3. landlordLiable: a current liable party's name is in landlordNames (normalised). rowPersonLiable: the row's person is a current liable party (nameMatch setting). hasStartDate / startDateMatches: about the current liability's start date; for a move-out the row's date is the end date (or the landlord's start date under landlordLiableFrom = dayAfter).

assignments.name: rowPersonLiable
assignments.value: ={{ $json.data.account.current.some(c => $('Case details').first().json.settings.nameMatch === 'surnameOnly' ? String(c.party ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim().split(' ').pop() === String($('Case details').first().json.case.tenantName ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim().split(' ').pop() : String(c.party ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim() === String($('Case details').first().json.case.tenantName ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim()) }}

nodes.name: Check 4: landlord liable? (moving in)
nodes.notes: Move-in: the landlord should be liable for the empty property.

nodes.name: Check 4: landlord liable? (moving out)
nodes.notes: Move-out: the landlord should not be liable yet.

nodes.name: Check 4: leaver is one of the liable people?
nodes.notes: Added safeguard, not in UiPath: stops the automation ending the wrong person's liability. Switched off by confirmLeaverIsLiable = false.

nodes.name: Check 4: RBIS has a start date?
Check 4: RBIS start date equals the row's date?
nodes.notes: Equal: RBIS already shows this change. Different: RBIS and the spreadsheet disagree.

nodes.name: Add the person to an existing tenancy?
nodes.notes: The flowchart's unconnected branch, off by default (addPersonToExistingTenancy). A move-in already in RBIS from the same date, from the required source system, whose person is not yet liable: add the person (addLiableParty, createDetail, setContactDetails). Otherwise the case is referred as ACCOUNT_ALREADY_PROCESSED.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('Case details').first().json.settings.addPersonToExistingTenancy === true && $('Case details').first().json.kind === 'moveIn' && String($('Case details').first().json.settings.requiredSourceSystem ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim() !== '' && String($('Case details').first().json.case.sourceSystem ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim() === String($('Case details').first().json.settings.requiredSourceSystem ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim() && !$('Check 4: who is liable in RBIS now?').first().json.rowPersonLiable }}

nodes.name: Path: add the person to the existing tenancy

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ planMode: 'addPerson', stepsDone: [], account: $('Check 4: who is liable in RBIS now?').first().json.account }) }}

nodes.name: Check 5: ask RBIS if the liability can be ended

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ operation: 'canTerminate', rbisBaseUrl: $('Case details').first().json.settings.rbisBaseUrl, ref: $('Case details').first().json.case.accountRef, params: {} }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ planMode: 'full', stepsDone: [], account: $('Check 4: who is liable in RBIS now?').first().json.account }) }}

nodes.name: Plan the RBIS steps
nodes.notes: Why Code: builds a list of RBIS calls whose length depends on the case (one addLiableParty and one setContactDetails per person on the tenancy), removes the calls already in stepsDone, and gives each remaining call the stepsDone list to record once it succeeds. Done natively this needs Split Out, several Set and Filter nodes and an Aggregate. Paths: moved in = endLiability (landlord), addLiableParty per person, createDetail, setContactDetails per person with details; moved out = endLiability (tenants), addLiableParty (landlord), setForwardingAddress if known; add a person = addLiableParty, createDetail, setContactDetails.

nodes.name: Loop over RBIS steps
nodes.notes: One RBIS call at a time, in order. A call that fails leaves the loop, so later calls are not made.

nodes.name: Current RBIS step
nodes.notes: Names the step being worked on, so later nodes can refer to it.

nodes.name: RBIS step done?
nodes.notes: Done includes 'already done': the change was already in RBIS.

nodes.name: Record the step
nodes.notes: Recorded straight away, so a retry never repeats a call that worked.

nodes.name: Reason: RBIS refused the step
nodes.notes: RBIS refused a person: UNABLE_TO_ADD_PARTY. RBIS would not end the liability: NO_OPTION_TO_TERMINATE, or CHECK_DATES if the end date is before the liability's start. Any other refusal is unexpected and the case is marked failed.

assignments.name: reasonCode
assignments.value: ={{ $('Current RBIS step').first().json.operation === 'addLiableParty' && $json.error?.httpStatus ? 'UNABLE_TO_ADD_PARTY' : $('Current RBIS step').first().json.operation === 'endLiability' && $json.error?.code === 'TERMINATION_NOT_ALLOWED' ? 'NO_OPTION_TO_TERMINATE' : $('Current RBIS step').first().json.operation === 'endLiability' && $json.error?.code === 'END_BEFORE_START' ? 'CHECK_DATES' : '' }}

value.reasonText: ={{ ({"DATES_INVALID":"The dates on the spreadsheet row are wrong or missing","DEATH_REFERRED":"The tenancy ended because the tenant died; these are passed to staff","CHANGE_REASON_NOT_VALID":"The reason for the change is not one the automation handles","SAME_TENANCY_AS_EARLIER_ROW":"Covered by an earlier row for the same tenancy","EARLIER_ROW_NOT_COMPLETED":"The earlier row for this tenancy was not completed, so this person was not added","NO_ACCOUNT_REF":"The row has no account reference","ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND":"The account could not be found in RBIS","NO_START_DATE":"RBIS has no start date to compare against","CHECK_DATES":"The dates in RBIS do not match the spreadsheet","ACCOUNT_ALREADY_PROCESSED":"RBIS already shows this change","LEAVER_NOT_LIABLE":"The person leaving is not the liable person in RBIS","NO_OPTION_TO_TERMINATE":"RBIS does not allow the current liability to be ended","UNABLE_TO_ADD_PARTY":"A person could not be added to the account","NO_CONTACT_DETAILS":"Liability started, but there were no contact details to record","RBIS_ERROR":"RBIS did not respond or returned an error","PROCESSING_STOPPED":"Processing stopped unexpectedly and the tries ran out"})[$('Plan the RBIS steps').first().json.followUpReason] ?? '' }}

nodes.name: Prepare the referral
nodes.notes: Every referral passes through here, whatever check or step stopped the case.

nodes.name: Refer case
nodes.notes: urgent: RBIS was already partly changed (stepsDone is not empty).

value.reasonText: ={{ ({"DATES_INVALID":"The dates on the spreadsheet row are wrong or missing","DEATH_REFERRED":"The tenancy ended because the tenant died; these are passed to staff","CHANGE_REASON_NOT_VALID":"The reason for the change is not one the automation handles","SAME_TENANCY_AS_EARLIER_ROW":"Covered by an earlier row for the same tenancy","EARLIER_ROW_NOT_COMPLETED":"The earlier row for this tenancy was not completed, so this person was not added","NO_ACCOUNT_REF":"The row has no account reference","ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND":"The account could not be found in RBIS","NO_START_DATE":"RBIS has no start date to compare against","CHECK_DATES":"The dates in RBIS do not match the spreadsheet","ACCOUNT_ALREADY_PROCESSED":"RBIS already shows this change","LEAVER_NOT_LIABLE":"The person leaving is not the liable person in RBIS","NO_OPTION_TO_TERMINATE":"RBIS does not allow the current liability to be ended","UNABLE_TO_ADD_PARTY":"A person could not be added to the account","NO_CONTACT_DETAILS":"Liability started, but there were no contact details to record","RBIS_ERROR":"RBIS did not respond or returned an error","PROCESSING_STOPPED":"Processing stopped unexpectedly and the tries ran out"})[$('Prepare the referral').first().json.reasonCode] ?? '' }}

nodes.name: Describe the error
nodes.notes: Every technical failure passes through here: RBIS unavailable, an unexpected RBIS answer, or an error in any step of this workflow.

nodes.name: Read the case before marking it failed
Mark case failed
nodes.notes: stepsDone is kept, so the automatic retry carries on where this try stopped. urgent: no tries left and RBIS partly changed.

value.reasonText: RBIS did not respond or returned an error
value.urgent: ={{ Number($json.attempts) >= Number($('When called by the Dispatcher').first().json.settings.maxAttempts ?? 3) && JSON.parse($json.stepsDone || '[]').length > 0 }}

nodes.name: Return the result
nodes.notes: Output for the Dispatcher's counts, taken from the case row as just written.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ caseId: $('When called by the Dispatcher').first().json.caseId, caseKey: $json.caseKey ?? '', claimed: true, status: $json.status ?? 'failed', reasonCode: $json.reasonCode ?? '', outcome: $json.outcome ?? '', urgent: $json.urgent === true }) }}

nodes.name: Return: result could not be recorded
nodes.notes: Last resort: the result could not even be written to the Cases table. The output still says failed, so the Performer never fails as a whole.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ caseId: $('When called by the Dispatcher').first().json.caseId ?? null, caseKey: '', claimed: true, status: 'failed', reasonCode: 'RBIS_ERROR', outcome: '', urgent: false }) }}

parameters.content:
## Start: claim the case
Claims the case so no other run works on it, reads it, and checks the row and settings can be used. A case already part-done in RBIS carries on from its recorded steps.

nodes.name: Note: Check 1: is the change complete and allowed?

parameters.content:
## Check 1: is the change complete and allowed?
Dates must be real and in order. Deaths go to staff unless the setting says to treat them as move-outs. The change reason must be one HARSLL handles.

nodes.name: Note: Check 2: has it already been done?

parameters.content:
## Check 2: has it already been done?
For joint tenants only the lead row changes RBIS. A second row follows what the lead row did: duplicate, wait for a later run, or refer.

nodes.name: Note: Check 3: can the account be found?

parameters.content:
## Check 3: can the account be found?
Asks RBIS for the account. On a retry, notices if an earlier try already made the first change, and carries on from there.

nodes.name: Note: Check 4: do RBIS and the housing record agree?

parameters.content:
## Check 4: do RBIS and the housing record agree?
Who is liable now? Moving in expects the landlord; moving out expects the leaver. A matching start date means the account was already updated.

nodes.name: Note: Check 5: will RBIS allow the change?

parameters.content:
## Check 5: will RBIS allow the change?
Asks RBIS whether the liability can be ended. If it can, the full update is planned.

nodes.name: Note: Update RBIS, one step at a time

parameters.content:
## Update RBIS, one step at a time
Plans the RBIS steps, then makes them one by one through the RBIS adapter, recording each step so a retry never repeats one.

## Finish: record the outcome
Updated, referred to staff, or failed. Every path ends by returning one result to the Dispatcher.

nodes.name: Note: how to read this workflow

parameters.content:
## HARSLL – Performer: one case, five checks
Runs once per case, called by the Dispatcher. Reads left to right.

- **Top row:** other paths (resume, joint rows, retries)
- **Middle row:** the main path when everything passes
- **Lower row (Reason: …):** a check failed, so the case goes to staff
- **Bottom row (Errors: …):** something went wrong; each section's errors are collected and the case is marked failed
